card.name: Words leading into advice to contact a doctor
card.fires_on: Commas, 'to' or 'seek' right before an instruction to contact or consult a doctor, usually after 'if symptoms persist or worsen' or 'advise patients to'.

modes.label: Comma after a symptom condition
modes.description: The comma that ends an if-clause about persisting or worsening symptoms, just before a call-your-doctor instruction.
modes.example: If symptoms worsen or persist for more than a week<<,>> discontinue use and contact a doctor.

modes.label: 'seek' before medical attention
modes.description: The verb 'seek' in advice to get immediate medical care.
modes.example: normally sustained or frequent and painful erections should<< seek>> immediate medical attention.

modes.label: Linking word before contacting
modes.description: A short linking word such as 'and' or 'to' just ahead of a verb for calling or contacting a doctor.
modes.example: discontinue use<< and>> contact a health care professional.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with consult, consultation and professional, as in advice to consult a professional.
card.plain: It fires at the point in a label where the text is about to tell the reader to see or call a doctor.
